title: Bound exact-grant timestamps to the documented RFC 3339 year range
outcome: Bound exact-grant timestamps to the documented RFC 3339 year range
acceptance: Exact grant reads refuse timestamps outside RFC 3339 years 0000 through 9999 as control_projection_invalid, or document a deliberately different supported timestamp contract; boundary tests cover both ends.

completion.summary: Exact-grant evidence refuses UTC timestamp years outside 0000–9999 with control_projection_invalid. Runtime-derived serialized endpoint and adjacent-millisecond tests cover every coherent slot, unchanged storage and no timestamp-order constraint. Full gate, independent Codex/Claude whole-input review and 1/1 independent acceptance passed. Pushed and installed; four live stores ready.
